title: samolus valerandi var. floribundus
intro: Samolus valerandi var. floribundus, commonly known as Marsh St. John's Wort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Primulaceae family. The Marsh St. John's Wort plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Therapeutically, it is used to treat various conditions, including digestive issues, wounds, and skin irritations, thanks to its soothing and protective actions. The bioactive constituents of Marsh St. John's Wort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
